name: Glutton Shackle
summary: In Silverpine Forest, Glutton Shackle bands lend strength to Arugal’s flawed sorcery. The mad archmage made them for Moonrage Glutton worgen.

sections.title: A Crutch for Weak Sorcery
sections.body:
Feral worgen infest Silverpine Forest, and the Forsaken’s trained mages see them as proof of poor arcane work. Dalar Dawnweaver, an accomplished arcanist stationed at the Sepulcher, holds Archmage Arugal in contempt. He calls Arugal an incompetent hack, unworthy of the Kirin Tor.

Dawnweaver found that Arugal relied on enchanted relics to shore up his fragile spells. The heavy Moonrage Gluttons roaming northern Silverpine wear Glutton Shackles. These magical anchors reinforce the curse binding the beasts.

sections.title: Fuel for Forsaken Countermeasures
sections.body:
Arugal bound raw enchantments directly into heavy iron bands. Even after their wearers are slain, magical energy remains in the shackles. Dawnweaver wants Forsaken agents to bring him the bands, so he can study their construction and siphon their reserves.

By examining the crude enchantments in the metal, the Forsaken hope to unravel the mysteries of the worgen curse. They aim to orchestrate the downfall of the beastmaster entrenched in Shadowfang Keep.

faq.answer: Moonrage Glutton worgen in Silverpine Forest wear Glutton Shackles, enchanted iron restraints. Archmage Arugal crafted the bands to reinforce their wearers with magic and shore up his flawed spells.

faq.q: Why does Dalar Dawnweaver want Glutton Shackles?
faq.answer: Dalar Dawnweaver wants the shackles to study Arugal’s crude enchantments and siphon their lingering magical energy. Understanding the items Arugal used to stabilize his beasts can help the Forsaken counter his magic.
Archmage Arugal enchanted the shackles. A former wizard of Dalaran, he summoned the worgen to fight the Scourge, then lost his mind and bound his creations to his will with magical trinkets.

faq.q: Where are the creatures wearing these shackles found?
faq.answer: Moonrage Gluttons roam the woods and abandoned farmsteads of central and northern Silverpine Forest. They often travel in packs alongside other corrupted Moonrage worgen.

angles.text: As a mage, you may recognize Dalar Dawnweaver’s biting critique of Arugal’s shoddy technique. Physical enchanted crutches to stabilize simple transmutation and summoning spells mark a wizard as mediocre.
As a Forsaken, you know gathering these shackles is essential to neutralizing the worgen threat pressing directly on the Sepulcher’s borders.
